bio.text: Carl Heastie represents the 83rd Assembly District in the northeast Bronx and was first elected to the Assembly in 2000.
He has been Speaker of the New York State Assembly since February 3, 2015, the first African American to lead the chamber.
Before joining the Assembly he was a budget analyst in the New York City Comptroller's office.
He holds a bachelor's degree in applied mathematics and statistics from Stony Brook University and an MBA from Baruch College.
